'''Chief Medical Scientist''' was a position held by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. As of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] held the title.
